No, “System Auto Search” is not a common or natural-sounding expression in everyday or professional English.

People would usually say things like:
- “automatic search”
- “system-wide search”
- “auto-search feature”
- “automatic system search” (if you really need both words)

“System Auto Search” sounds like a literal or direct translation, or like a label in software where space is limited (e.g., a button name). If this is for a UI, you might rename it depending on what it does, for example:
- If it automatically searches as the user types: “Search as you type” / “Auto-search”
- If it searches the whole system: “Search entire system” / “System search”
- If it runs a search automatically on a schedule: “Automatic system scan” / “Scheduled search”

If you tell me where you plan to use the phrase (button text, menu item, documentation, etc.), I can suggest a more natural alternative.
